FAQ

Questions parents ask

My child is scared. What then?

We start slowly with games and small goals on easy terrain. Nobody is rushed, and your child decides when to try the next step.

What should we wear and bring?

Warm layers (avoid cotton), waterproof jacket and trousers, gloves, goggles, a helmet and sun cream. Snow reflects UV light, so sunburn is common.

What does the price include?

Instruction only. Lift pass and equipment are booked separately. Message me and I’ll help you plan it all.

How do I book?

Only through WhatsApp. Send your request and I’ll confirm the time quickly.

Which language will the lesson be in?

Bulgarian, English or Russian. Tell me your choice when you book.
